title: TP-Link Tapo D210 Video Doorbell Camera $74 Delivered @ Telstra
body:
Deal: TP-Link Tapo D210 Video Doorbell Camera $74 Delivered @ Telstra

[dilligafocau] Nice find, paid $115 for one of these last week
[rahuahuj] Is this your first video doorbell? Would be good to know your experience once you have used it for a few days.
[Big L] I've had this for 18 months or so. Works really well, although I haven't bothered with the AI component to recognise our car, occupants, etc. so I can't comment on that. I'm recharging it every six months. Getting the zones correct to trigger the notification is pretty easy, but I did have a few tries for trial and error as I only wanted alerts inside my house boundary.
Remember to turn off the anti-theft before you take it off to charge it, otherwise you have to do a reset.
If you can wire in your video doorbell, it's a much better option as you can use it with DVR and obviously don't have to recharge.
[dilligafocau] Yes it is, hopefully mounting it in place tomorrow. Thus far Ive paired with the included chime and a Tapo H500 Hub Telstra had going cheap a few weeks back
[generalpayne] I had a couple of these. The first one I had a year or two ago had a sensor in the front and gave much better video (you can see it in the photo between the camera lens and the button) . Second one was same model, photos showed the same sensor, but it was an updated version and didn't have the sensor. Much worse video. Returned it and am still looking for the version shown in the photos with the sensor.
From my research, the v2 model was changed from 2 sensor to 1 sensor and has a smaller battery too. Keep this in mind as most positive reviews would have been earlier models with the 2 sensors, whereas now stock is 1 sensor. At least that's been my Amazon experience.
[highwind] Seems I have the V1 model, and can confirm it has good video quality and battery life. No complaints about V1 model!
[jwh] You're not wrong…
One lists here whether you pick V1 or V2;
Dual PIR Motion Sensor (FOV: 150° horizontal)
One Ambient Light Sensor
6400 mAh Built-in Rechargeable Lithium-ion Battery
While the other lists;
Single PIR Motion Sensor
Motion Detection Range: 25 ft
5200 mAh Built-in Rechargeable Lithium-ion Battery
You can see the missing sensor, but no mention of changes to the camera sensor. Really should have a different model name when they change things.
[generalpayne] Yeah I've been trying to find a v1 version, as it was good.
[miaza0] The specs on the Telstra site says "Power Source: 6400 mAh Built-in Rechargeable Lithium-ion Battery", so this should be V1 I think?
[generalpayne] @miaza0: The second one I bought on Amazon did too and had the old stock photos showing the second pid. I won't be risking it but hopefully whoever does gets the v1.
[EversonRibeiro] I have one for about 3 month and works just fine. Find the clips a bit short and AI recognition could be better. But happy overall
[greywine] Getting an error at checkout : " Can't continue with this order . Message Us. " Anybody else seeing it ?
[Lps] no. but then again i'm not trying to buy one.
[Iamgonnabuythat] Keep trying. Saw same message twice. Started chatting and in between chats tried, worked.
[greywine] Ok will have another few go!
Edit - changed payment method to PayPal and it worked.
[ledgisv2] If you dont mind charging it once a month then go for it. No subscription required for general use.
[Porco Rosso] Trying to buy this but annoyed that they need to verify my id (diver license or passport)…any way around this?
[tonka] Apart from being intrusive, some don't have this ID. I notice they are also pushing compulsory use of the app. That's gonna be the final straw for us with Telstra.
[Porco Rosso] Agreed! I kind of was wondering where was the guest or paypal checkout when they forced me to verify the email.
I'm going to try and see if OW will price match this tomorrow. Not wanting to give id details to telstra.
I guess if I was signing up for a phone with a new number or a plan, they could ask for it, but buying a doorbell, seriously?
[Iamgonnabuythat] Tried with OWs. They disagreed to match/beat both online and in store. Apparently Telstra site doesnt have product code to verify exact product (per OWs employee) and they dont have clear return policy (per phone employee).
[tonka] @Iamgonnabuythat: They don't have any return policy I could find when I got some DOA stuff. I gave up in end and just added it to the Telstra lifetime trauma tally.
[tonka] License or passport required for me to complete checkout.
[Owgasm] I have a Ring doorbell 2 and my chime has died.
(Pay the yearly subscription $49.95)
I’ve got expiring Telstra points.
Would this be equivalent or better?
[Owgasm] Oh boy. Didn’t realise how old my Ring Doorbell 2 was.
Upgrade time.
30,600 points.
Now to pay through the nose for an SD Card….
[dlakers3peat] Thanks exactly what I needed. I have eufy video door bell which works fine but i have to charge the battery every 2 weeks and that's with motion detection off. Hopefully this will be much better.
[Wiser] What is use of built in SD card if the unit is stolen?
[dlakers3peat] I have some tp link cameras which came with TP-Link Tapo Smart Hub which is plugged into the router. This smart hub has slot for an sd card. You can buy this Smart Hub separately for about $70.
[prankster] That’s with any Tapo camera - technically you can wank it off if you really wanted too. The only options would be
1) pay the cloud service which at least you have footage of the unit being stolen before power is d/c
2) put the option of alarm when device is being tampered
[prankster] Pretty good deal - had the d130 shipped from Amazon back in 2024 when it was early models so I think I had to get it from USA but I wanted a wired version but all good got that wired up with Aussie adaptor.Costed me $63 so $74 for this new version is not bad ✌️
Usage wise it’s been fine apart from sometimes lag or connection drop which is random / annoying so this model hopefully should be a better upgrade 😊
Good to see this unit is both battery and wired
